title: Candidate brief + reviewer slots for Senior Infra SWE - Morales
content:
['From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate brief + reviewer slots for Senior Infra SWE - Morales

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us. Attached is the take-home brief for the Senior Infrastructure SWE role. High-level details:

- Deliverable: a short design + proof-of-concept (code repo or runnable notebook) that demonstrates an optimized KV cache sharding strategy for a multi-tenant inference runtime.
- Expected length: 2–4 pages of design + a minimal runnable example.
- Deadline: Tue, Dec 28, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT.
- Submission method: reply to this thread with a zip or a link to a GitHub repo (private OK) and the completed scoring checklist attached.

We’ve attached the prompt (infra_takehome.pdf) and our scoring rubric (scoring_sheet.xlsx). Reviewers on our side will be Laura and Marissa as primary graders; Dev will be the tie-breaker/architecture sanity check. We plan a 45-minute calibration + scoring sync on Mon, Jan 3 — proposed window 9:00–9:45 AM PT.

If you need any clarification on the prompt or an extension to the deadline, let me know — we can be flexible if you’re traveling. Please confirm receipt when you get this.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments: infra_takehome.pdf (PDF), scoring_sheet.xlsx (Excel)

Hi Camila —

Got it, thank you. I can confirm receipt of the brief and rubric. Quick question: I’m traveling next week and would like to request a 48-hour extension if possible (new deadline Dec 30 at 11:59 PM PT). Also — for the runnable component, can I use a small local simulator rather than real GPUs? I want to avoid requiring you to run heavy infrastructure.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
(elena.morales@gmail.com)

Camila —

On Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 10:03 AM Elena Morales <elena.morales@gmail.com> wrote:
> Got it, thank you. I can confirm receipt of the brief and rubric. Quick question: I’m traveling next week and would like to request a 48-hour extension if possible (new deadline Dec 30 at 11:59 PM PT). Also — for the runnable component, can I use a small local simulator rather than real GPUs? I want to avoid requiring you to run heavy infrastructure.

I’m fine approving a 48-hour courtesy extension — we should be consistent with the policy for seniors. Marissa, Dev — can you commit to having reviews completed by Fri, Jan 1 so we can still do calibration on Mon, Jan 3? If reviewers need more time, we can push the sync but that’s not ideal since Jan 3 is the week we want to finalize offers.

On the runnable component: yes, a local simulator or minimal dockerized example is fine as long as it demonstrates the approach. Please add a short README with instructions and a Dockerfile or requirements.txt.

Proposed next steps:
- Approve extension to Dec 30 11:59 PM PT (Camila to confirm to candidate)
- Marissa & Laura = primary scoring; Dev = architecture sanity check and tiebreak
- Block Jan 3 09:00–09:45 PT for calibration (I’ll send the invite once reviewers confirm)

Laura
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Marissa/Laura/Dev — can you each confirm that you can complete your reviews by Jan 1 EOD PT? I’ll send the Jan 3 calibration invite once I have confirmations.

Elena — I’ve updated the Drive folder (link below) with the final brief and the rubric; attaching here again for convenience. If anything changes, ping me directly.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_cand-brief-Infra-2026

Camila
